"""SPEC §15.6 live writes: incidents, models, deduplicated proposals and analyst decisions
(D-097)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pytest

from kairos_defense.match.types import Match
from kairos_defense.memory.actions import (
    CaseExists,
    ProposalAlreadyDecided,
    ProposalNotFound,
    WrongCase,
    decide_link,
    json_safe,
    open_case,
    propose_matches,
    record_incident,
    register_model,
)
from kairos_defense.store.ledger_duck import DuckCaseMemory
from tests.unit.memory_kit import delta_story

CASE = "CASE-P1-DELTA-260419"
LIVE = "DEMO-BRAVO-0828"
T90 = datetime(2026, 8, 29, 2, 41, 36)


@pytest.fixture
def mem(cfg, tmp_path):
    with DuckCaseMemory(tmp_path / "mem.duckdb", cfg.app) as m:
        m.append_many(delta_story())
        yield m


def _m(inc: str, score: float, warp: float = 1.1) -> Match:
    return Match(LIVE, f"{inc}-T1", inc, inc.split("-")[1], datetime(2026, 1, 1), score, 0.8,
                 {"shape_sim": 0.8, "rf_match": 1.0}, ["Same RF family (FAM-07)"], warp, 0,
                 "fusion-v1")  # fmt: skip


TOP = [_m("P1-DELTA-260419", 0.97), _m("P1-ALPHA-260303", 0.93), _m("P1-CHARLIE-260710", 0.71)]


def _proposals(mem) -> list[dict]:
    return [r for r in mem.events() if r["event_type"] == "match_proposed"]


def test_record_incident_event_fields(mem) -> None:
    inc = {"incident_id": LIVE, "installation_id": "BRAVO", "region_id": "COASTAL",
           "start_ts": datetime(2026, 8, 29, 2, 40, 6), "n_tracks": 1, "is_swarm": False}
    seq = record_incident(mem, inc, inc["start_ts"])
    r = mem.events()[-1]
    assert (r["seq"], r["actor"], r["subject_id"], r["valid_from"], r["valid_to"]) == (
        seq, "system", LIVE, inc["start_ts"], None)  # fmt: skip
    assert r["recorded_at"] == inc["start_ts"] and r["object_json"]["base"] == "BRAVO"
    assert record_incident(mem, inc, T90) == seq and mem.count() == 8


def test_register_model_once_per_version(mem) -> None:
    a = register_model(mem, "fusion-v1", "ab" * 32, T90, "models/fusion_v1.json", {"auc": 0.99})
    assert register_model(mem, "fusion-v1", "ab" * 32, T90 + timedelta(seconds=5)) == a
    b = register_model(mem, "fusion-v1", "cd" * 32, T90)
    assert b == a + 1 and mem.events()[-1]["object_json"]["sha256"] == "cd" * 32


def test_propose_matches_writes_one_event_per_top3_match(mem) -> None:
    ms = [*TOP[:2], _m("P1-CHARLIE-260710", 0.71, float("nan")), _m("P1-ALPHA-260502", 0.6)]
    seqs = propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, ms, T90, query_track=f"{LIVE}-T1", t_s=90)
    assert seqs == [8, 9, 10]
    rows = _proposals(mem)
    assert [r["subject_id"] for r in rows] == ["P1-DELTA-260419", "P1-ALPHA-260303",
                                                "P1-CHARLIE-260710"]  # fmt: skip
    r = rows[1]
    o = r["object_json"]
    assert (r["actor"], r["case_id"], r["predicate"], r["confidence"], r["source_id"]) == (
        "matcher@fusion-v1", CASE, "member_of", 0.93, "fusion-v1")  # fmt: skip
    assert (o["query_incident"], o["query_track"], o["match_track"], o["rank"], o["t_s"]) == (
        LIVE, f"{LIVE}-T1", "P1-ALPHA-260303-T1", 2, 90)  # fmt: skip
    assert o["top3"] == [r["subject_id"] for r in rows] and o["reasons"]
    assert o["features"]["rf_match"] == 1.0 and o["model_version"] == "fusion-v1"
    assert rows[2]["object_json"]["warp_ratio"] is None  # NaN -> null
    assert {x["recorded_at"] for x in rows} == {T90}


def test_propose_skips_same_set_within_005(mem) -> None:
    propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90)
    moved = [_m("P1-ALPHA-260303", 0.95), _m("P1-DELTA-260419", 0.93), TOP[2]]  # same set
    assert propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, moved, T90 + timedelta(seconds=1)) == []
    assert len(_proposals(mem)) == 3


def test_propose_appends_when_score_moves_more_than_005(mem) -> None:
    propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90)
    moved = [TOP[0], _m("P1-ALPHA-260303", 0.87), TOP[2]]
    assert len(propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, moved, T90 + timedelta(seconds=1))) == 3


def test_propose_appends_on_set_change_and_skips_on_rerun(mem) -> None:
    propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90)
    other = [TOP[0], TOP[1], _m("P1-ALPHA-260502", 0.70)]
    t120 = T90 + timedelta(seconds=30)
    assert len(propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, other, t120)) == 3
    assert propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90) == []  # seek back to T+90: known batch
    assert propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, other, t120) == []  # a re-run of T+120
    assert propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, [], t120) == []
    assert len(_proposals(mem)) == 6


def test_decide_link_approve_and_reject(mem) -> None:
    a, b, c = propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90)
    ok = decide_link(mem, CASE, b, "approve", "duty_officer", T90, "same orbit")
    no = decide_link(mem, CASE, c, "reject", "duty_officer", T90, "different target")
    rows = {r["seq"]: r for r in mem.events()}
    assert rows[ok]["event_type"] == "link_approved" and rows[ok]["actor"] == "analyst:duty_officer"
    assert rows[ok]["object_json"] == {"proposal_seq": b, "query_incident": LIVE,
                                       "rationale": "same orbit"}  # fmt: skip
    assert rows[no]["event_type"] == "link_rejected" and rows[no]["supersedes_seq"] == c
    s = mem.as_of(CASE, T90)
    assert s.members == ["P1-DELTA-260419", "P1-ALPHA-260303"] and s.pending == []
    decide_link(mem, CASE, a, "approve", "duty_officer", T90)  # the founder: still decidable
    assert mem.as_of(CASE, T90).members == ["P1-DELTA-260419", "P1-ALPHA-260303"]


def test_decide_link_twice_or_wrong_case_raises(mem) -> None:
    a, b, _ = propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90)
    decide_link(mem, CASE, a, "approve", "x", T90)
    decide_link(mem, CASE, b, "reject", "x", T90)
    for seq in (a, b):
        for d in ("approve", "reject"):
            with pytest.raises(ProposalAlreadyDecided):
                decide_link(mem, CASE, seq, d, "x", T90)
    with pytest.raises(ProposalNotFound):
        decide_link(mem, CASE, 1, "approve", "x", T90)  # an incident row
    with pytest.raises(ProposalNotFound):
        decide_link(mem, CASE, 999, "approve", "x", T90)
    with pytest.raises(WrongCase):
        decide_link(mem, "CASE-P1-ALPHA-260303", 10, "approve", "x", T90)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="handle"):
        decide_link(mem, CASE, 10, "approve", "Person Name Example", T90)


def test_open_case_uses_case_dash_incident_and_refuses_existing(mem) -> None:
    seq = open_case(mem, "P1-ALPHA-260502", "analyst:a", T90, base="ALPHA")
    r = mem.events()[-1]
    assert (r["seq"], r["case_id"], r["subject_id"]) == (seq, "CASE-P1-ALPHA-260502",
                                                         "P1-ALPHA-260502")  # fmt: skip
    assert mem.as_of("CASE-P1-ALPHA-260502", T90).status == "open"
    with pytest.raises(CaseExists):
        open_case(mem, "P1-ALPHA-260502", "analyst:a", T90)
    with pytest.raises(CaseExists):
        open_case(mem, "P1-DELTA-260419", "analyst:a", T90)
    assert json_safe({"x": (float("inf"), 1)}) == {"x": [None, 1]}

"""SPEC §15.6 live writes: incidents, models, deduplicated proposals and analyst decisions
(D-097)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pytest

from kairos_defense.match.types import Match
from kairos_defense.memory.actions import (
    CaseExists,
    ProposalAlreadyDecided,
    ProposalNotFound,
    WrongCase,
    decide_link,
    json_safe,
    open_case,
    propose_matches,
    record_incident,
    register_model,
)
from kairos_defense.store.ledger_duck import DuckCaseMemory
from tests.unit.memory_kit import delta_story

CASE = "CASE-P1-DELTA-260419"
LIVE = "DEMO-BRAVO-0828"
T90 = datetime(2026, 8, 29, 2, 41, 36)


@pytest.fixture
def mem(cfg, tmp_path):
    with DuckCaseMemory(tmp_path / "mem.duckdb", cfg.app) as m:
        m.append_many(delta_story())
        yield m


def _m(inc: str, score: float, warp: float = 1.1) -> Match:
    return Match(LIVE, f"{inc}-T1", inc, inc.split("-")[1], datetime(2026, 1, 1), score, 0.8,
                 {"shape_sim": 0.8, "rf_match": 1.0}, ["Same RF family (FAM-07)"], warp, 0,
                 "fusion-v1")  # fmt: skip


TOP = [_m("P1-DELTA-260419", 0.97), _m("P1-ALPHA-260303", 0.93), _m("P1-CHARLIE-260710", 0.71)]


def _proposals(mem) -> list[dict]:
    return [r for r in mem.events() if r["event_type"] == "match_proposed"]


def test_record_incident_event_fields(mem) -> None:
    inc = {"incident_id": LIVE, "installation_id": "BRAVO", "region_id": "COASTAL",
           "start_ts": datetime(2026, 8, 29, 2, 40, 6), "n_tracks": 1, "is_swarm": False}
    seq = record_incident(mem, inc, inc["start_ts"])
    r = mem.events()[-1]
    assert (r["seq"], r["actor"], r["subject_id"], r["valid_from"], r["valid_to"]) == (
        seq, "system", LIVE, inc["start_ts"], None)  # fmt: skip
    assert r["recorded_at"] == inc["start_ts"] and r["object_json"]["base"] == "BRAVO"
    assert record_incident(mem, inc, T90) == seq and mem.count() == 8


def test_register_model_once_per_version(mem) -> None:
    a = register_model(mem, "fusion-v1", "ab" * 32, T90, "models/fusion_v1.json", {"auc": 0.99})
    assert register_model(mem, "fusion-v1", "ab" * 32, T90 + timedelta(seconds=5)) == a
    b = register_model(mem, "fusion-v1", "cd" * 32, T90)
    assert b == a + 1 and mem.events()[-1]["object_json"]["sha256"] == "cd" * 32


def test_propose_matches_writes_one_event_per_top3_match(mem) -> None:
    ms = [*TOP[:2], _m("P1-CHARLIE-260710", 0.71, float("nan")), _m("P1-ALPHA-260502", 0.6)]
    seqs = propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, ms, T90, query_track=f"{LIVE}-T1", t_s=90)
    assert seqs == [8, 9, 10]
    rows = _proposals(mem)
    assert [r["subject_id"] for r in rows] == ["P1-DELTA-260419", "P1-ALPHA-260303",
                                                "P1-CHARLIE-260710"]  # fmt: skip
    r = rows[1]
    o = r["object_json"]
    assert (r["actor"], r["case_id"], r["predicate"], r["confidence"], r["source_id"]) == (
        "matcher@fusion-v1", CASE, "member_of", 0.93, "fusion-v1")  # fmt: skip
    assert (o["query_incident"], o["query_track"], o["match_track"], o["rank"], o["t_s"]) == (
        LIVE, f"{LIVE}-T1", "P1-ALPHA-260303-T1", 2, 90)  # fmt: skip
    assert o["top3"] == [r["subject_id"] for r in rows] and o["reasons"]
    assert o["features"]["rf_match"] == 1.0 and o["model_version"] == "fusion-v1"
    assert rows[2]["object_json"]["warp_ratio"] is None  # NaN -> null
    assert {x["recorded_at"] for x in rows} == {T90}


def test_propose_skips_same_set_within_005(mem) -> None:
    propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90)
    moved = [_m("P1-ALPHA-260303", 0.95), _m("P1-DELTA-260419", 0.93), TOP[2]]  # same set
    assert propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, moved, T90 + timedelta(seconds=1)) == []
    assert len(_proposals(mem)) == 3


def test_propose_appends_when_score_moves_more_than_005(mem) -> None:
    propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90)
    moved = [TOP[0], _m("P1-ALPHA-260303", 0.87), TOP[2]]
    assert len(propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, moved, T90 + timedelta(seconds=1))) == 3


def test_propose_appends_on_set_change_and_skips_on_rerun(mem) -> None:
    propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90)
    other = [TOP[0], TOP[1], _m("P1-ALPHA-260502", 0.70)]
    t120 = T90 + timedelta(seconds=30)
    assert len(propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, other, t120)) == 3
    assert propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90) == []  # seek back to T+90: known batch
    assert propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, other, t120) == []  # a re-run of T+120
    assert propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, [], t120) == []
    assert len(_proposals(mem)) == 6


def test_decide_link_approve_and_reject(mem) -> None:
    a, b, c = propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90)
    ok = decide_link(mem, CASE, b, "approve", "duty_officer", T90, "same orbit")
    no = decide_link(mem, CASE, c, "reject", "duty_officer", T90, "different target")
    rows = {r["seq"]: r for r in mem.events()}
    assert rows[ok]["event_type"] == "link_approved" and rows[ok]["actor"] == "analyst:duty_officer"
    assert rows[ok]["object_json"] == {"proposal_seq": b, "query_incident": LIVE,
                                       "rationale": "same orbit"}  # fmt: skip
    assert rows[no]["event_type"] == "link_rejected" and rows[no]["supersedes_seq"] == c
    s = mem.as_of(CASE, T90)
    assert s.members == ["P1-DELTA-260419", "P1-ALPHA-260303"] and s.pending == []
    decide_link(mem, CASE, a, "approve", "duty_officer", T90)  # the founder: still decidable
    assert mem.as_of(CASE, T90).members == ["P1-DELTA-260419", "P1-ALPHA-260303"]


def test_decide_link_twice_or_wrong_case_raises(mem) -> None:
    a, b, _ = propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90)
    decide_link(mem, CASE, a, "approve", "x", T90)
    decide_link(mem, CASE, b, "reject", "x", T90)
    for seq in (a, b):
        for d in ("approve", "reject"):
            with pytest.raises(ProposalAlreadyDecided):
                decide_link(mem, CASE, seq, d, "x", T90)
    with pytest.raises(ProposalNotFound):
        decide_link(mem, CASE, 1, "approve", "x", T90)  # an incident row
    with pytest.raises(ProposalNotFound):
        decide_link(mem, CASE, 999, "approve", "x", T90)
    with pytest.raises(WrongCase):
        decide_link(mem, "CASE-P1-ALPHA-260303", 10, "approve", "x", T90)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="handle"):
        decide_link(mem, CASE, 10, "approve", "Person Name Example", T90)


def test_open_case_uses_case_dash_incident_and_refuses_existing(mem) -> None:
    seq = open_case(mem, "P1-ALPHA-260502", "analyst:a", T90, base="ALPHA")
    r = mem.events()[-1]
    assert (r["seq"], r["case_id"], r["subject_id"]) == (seq, "CASE-P1-ALPHA-260502",
                                                         "P1-ALPHA-260502")  # fmt: skip
    assert mem.as_of("CASE-P1-ALPHA-260502", T90).status == "open"
    with pytest.raises(CaseExists):
        open_case(mem, "P1-ALPHA-260502", "analyst:a", T90)
    with pytest.raises(CaseExists):
        open_case(mem, "P1-DELTA-260419", "analyst:a", T90)
    assert json_safe({"x": (float("inf"), 1)}) == {"x": [None, 1]}

"""SPEC §15.8 shift delta: rows recorded in (since, until], grouped, with evidence refs (D-101)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json

import pytest

from kairos_defense.memory.actions import decide_link, propose_matches, retract
from kairos_defense.memory.delta import GROUPS, delta
from kairos_defense.store.ledger_duck import DuckCaseMemory
from tests.unit.memory_kit import assessment, delta_story, ev, incident, local, report

CASE = "CASE-P1-DELTA-260419"
DELTA = "P1-DELTA-260419"
SHIFT = (local(2026, 8, 28, 18, 0), local(2026, 8, 29, 6, 0))


def _top() -> list[dict]:
    return [{"incident_id": i, "score": s, "track_id": f"{i}-T1", "model_version": "fusion-v1"}
            for i, s in ((DELTA, 0.97), ("P1-ALPHA-260303", 0.93),
                         ("P1-CHARLIE-260710", 0.7))]  # fmt: skip


@pytest.fixture
def mem(cfg, tmp_path):
    with DuckCaseMemory(tmp_path / "mem.duckdb", cfg.app) as m:
        m.append_many(delta_story())
        t = local(2026, 8, 28, 21, 41)
        m.append(incident("DEMO-BRAVO-0828", "BRAVO", local(2026, 8, 28, 21, 33)))
        m.append(report("R-DEMO-BRAVO-0828-1", "DEMO-BRAVO-0828", "BRAVO", t, t))
        m.append(ev("model_registered", t, object_json={"version": "fusion-v1", "sha256": "ab"}))
        a, b, c = propose_matches(m, CASE, "DEMO-BRAVO-0828", _top(), t)
        decide_link(m, CASE, b, "approve", "duty", t)
        decide_link(m, CASE, c, "reject", "duty", t)
        yield m


def test_delta_groups_and_refs(mem) -> None:
    d = delta(mem.events(), *SHIFT)
    g = d.groups
    assert list(g) == list(GROUPS)
    assert [i["subject_id"] for i in g["incidents"]] == ["DEMO-BRAVO-0828"]
    assert [i["subject_id"] for i in g["reports"]] == ["R-DEMO-BRAVO-0828-1"]
    assert len(g["proposals"]) == 3 and len(g["models"]) == 1
    assert [i["subject_id"] for i in g["links_approved"]] == ["P1-ALPHA-260303"]
    assert [i["supersedes_seq"] for i in g["links_rejected"]] == [g["proposals"][2]["seq"]]
    assert g["assessments_added"] == g["decisions"] == g["exports"] == []
    seqs = {r["seq"] for r in mem.events()}
    for items in g.values():
        for i in items:
            assert i["seq"] in seqs and i["summary"] and i["recorded_at"] > SHIFT[0]
    assert d.count == 10 and d.head_seq == mem.head().seq
    assert json.loads(json.dumps(d.to_dict()))["count"] == 10


def test_delta_window_bounds(mem) -> None:
    rows = mem.events()
    t = local(2026, 8, 28, 21, 41)
    assert delta(rows, t, SHIFT[1]).count == 1  # (since: exclusive: only the incident at end+5
    assert delta(rows, SHIFT[0], t).count == 9  # until: inclusive
    assert delta(rows, local(2026, 4, 20, 9, 9), local(2026, 4, 20, 9, 10)).groups[
        "decisions"][0]["event_type"] == "case_opened"  # fmt: skip


def test_delta_installation_filter(mem) -> None:
    rows = mem.events()
    bravo = delta(rows, *SHIFT, installation_id="BRAVO").groups
    assert len(bravo["incidents"]) == 1 and len(bravo["proposals"]) == 3  # query at BRAVO
    assert bravo["models"] == []  # no installation
    charlie = delta(rows, *SHIFT, installation_id="CHARLIE").groups
    assert [i["subject_id"] for i in charlie["proposals"]] == []  # no CHARLIE incident recorded
    delta_base = delta(rows, *SHIFT, installation_id="DELTA").groups
    assert len(delta_base["proposals"]) == 3  # all three target the DELTA case
    assert delta(rows, *SHIFT, installation_id="KILO").count == 0


def test_delta_contradictions_opened_in_window(mem) -> None:
    t = local(2026, 8, 28, 22, 0)
    seq = mem.append(assessment(DELTA, "probing", t, local(2026, 4, 19, 21, 35),
                                actor="analyst:a"))  # fmt: skip
    g = delta(mem.events(), *SHIFT).groups
    assert [(i["seq"], i["values"]) for i in g["contradictions_opened"]] == [
        (seq, ["hobbyist", "probing"])]  # fmt: skip
    assert len(g["assessments_added"]) == 1
    later = (SHIFT[1], local(2026, 8, 30, 6, 0))
    assert delta(mem.events(), *later).groups["contradictions_opened"] == []  # already open


def test_delta_assessment_retracted(mem) -> None:
    t = local(2026, 8, 28, 23, 0)
    links = [r for r in mem.events() if r["event_type"] == "link_approved"]
    retract(mem, 5, "analyst:a", t, "hobbyist was wrong")
    retract(mem, links[0]["seq"], "analyst:a", t, "linked by mistake")
    g = delta(mem.events(), *SHIFT).groups
    assert [(i["supersedes_seq"], i["retracts"]) for i in g["assessments_retracted"]] == [
        (5, "assessment_asserted")]  # fmt: skip
    assert [i["retracts"] for i in g["retractions"]] == ["link_approved"]

def _m(inc: str, score: float, warp: float = 1.1) -> Match:
    return Match(LIVE, f"{inc}-T1", inc, inc.split("-")[1], datetime(2026, 1, 1), score, 0.8,
                 {"shape_sim": 0.8, "rf_match": 1.0}, ["Same RF family (FAM-07)"], warp, 0,

TOP = [_m("P1-DELTA-260419", 0.97), _m("P1-ALPHA-260303", 0.93), _m("P1-CHARLIE-260710", 0.71)]


def _proposals(mem) -> list[dict]:
    return [r for r in mem.events() if r["event_type"] == "match_proposed"]


def test_record_incident_event_fields(mem) -> None:
    inc = {"incident_id": LIVE, "installation_id": "BRAVO", "region_id": "COASTAL",
           "start_ts": datetime(2026, 8, 29, 2, 40, 6), "n_tracks": 1, "is_swarm": False}
    seq = record_incident(mem, inc, inc["start_ts"])
    r = mem.events()[-1]
    assert (r["seq"], r["actor"], r["subject_id"], r["valid_from"], r["valid_to"]) == (
        seq, "system", LIVE, inc["start_ts"], None)  # fmt: skip
    assert r["recorded_at"] == inc["start_ts"] and r["object_json"]["base"] == "BRAVO"
    assert record_incident(mem, inc, T90) == seq and mem.count() == 8


def test_register_model_once_per_version(mem) -> None:

    assert register_model(mem, "fusion-v1", "ab" * 32, T90 + timedelta(seconds=5)) == a
    b = register_model(mem, "fusion-v1", "cd" * 32, T90)
    assert b == a + 1 and mem.events()[-1]["object_json"]["sha256"] == "cd" * 32

    seqs = propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, ms, T90, query_track=f"{LIVE}-T1", t_s=90)

def test_decide_link_approve_and_reject(mem) -> None:
    a, b, c = propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90)
    ok = decide_link(mem, CASE, b, "approve", "duty_officer", T90, "same orbit")
    no = decide_link(mem, CASE, c, "reject", "duty_officer", T90, "different target")
    rows = {r["seq"]: r for r in mem.events()}
    assert rows[ok]["event_type"] == "link_approved" and rows[ok]["actor"] == "analyst:duty_officer"
    assert rows[ok]["object_json"] == {"proposal_seq": b, "query_incident": LIVE,
                                       "rationale": "same orbit"}  # fmt: skip
    assert rows[no]["event_type"] == "link_rejected" and rows[no]["supersedes_seq"] == c
    s = mem.as_of(CASE, T90)
    assert s.members == ["P1-DELTA-260419", "P1-ALPHA-260303"] and s.pending == []
    decide_link(mem, CASE, a, "approve", "duty_officer", T90)  # the founder: still decidable
    assert mem.as_of(CASE, T90).members == ["P1-DELTA-260419", "P1-ALPHA-260303"]


def test_decide_link_twice_or_wrong_case_raises(mem) -> None:
    a, b, _ = propose_matches(mem, CASE, LIVE, TOP, T90)
    decide_link(mem, CASE, a, "approve", "x", T90)
    decide_link(mem, CASE, b, "reject", "x", T90)
    for seq in (a, b):
        for d in ("approve", "reject"):
            with pytest.raises(ProposalAlreadyDecided):
                decide_link(mem, CASE, seq, d, "x", T90)
    with pytest.raises(ProposalNotFound):
        decide_link(mem, CASE, 1, "approve", "x", T90)  # an incident row
    with pytest.raises(ProposalNotFound):
        decide_link(mem, CASE, 999, "approve", "x", T90)
    with pytest.raises(WrongCase):
        decide_link(mem, "CASE-P1-ALPHA-260303", 10, "approve", "x", T90)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="handle"):
        decide_link(mem, CASE, 10, "approve", "Person Name Example", T90)

"""SPEC §15.5 seeding on the generator's real output for the six P1 nights (D-096), and the §20
phase 6 tests: DELTA as of 2026-04-20 10:00 local, and three members after the demo links."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter
from datetime import timedelta

import pytest

from kairos_defense.memory.actions import decide_link, propose_matches
from kairos_defense.memory.diff import group
from kairos_defense.memory.seed import SeedError, seed, seed_events
from kairos_defense.store.duck import DuckTrackStore
from kairos_defense.store.ledger_duck import DuckCaseMemory
from tests.unit.memory_kit import local

CASE = "CASE-P1-DELTA-260419"
DELTA = "P1-DELTA-260419"
THEN = local(2026, 4, 20, 9, 10)


@pytest.fixture
def store(seeded_p1):
    with DuckTrackStore(seeded_p1.cfg.app.paths.duckdb, seeded_p1.cfg.app) as s:
        yield s


def test_seed_counts_match_the_store(seeded_p1, store, ledger_copy) -> None:
    cut = seeded_p1.summary.cutoff
    q = {"c": cut}
    hist = "JOIN incidents i USING (incident_id) WHERE i.status <> 'live'"
    expected = {
        "incident_recorded": store.sql("SELECT count(*) n FROM incidents WHERE status <> 'live' "
                                       "AND end_ts + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE < $c", q).n[0],
        "report_recorded": store.sql(f"SELECT count(*) n FROM reports r {hist} "
                                     "AND r.report_ts < $c", q).n[0],
        "assessment_asserted": store.sql(f"SELECT count(*) n FROM assessments a {hist} "
                                         "AND a.assessed_ts < $c", q).n[0],
        "case_opened": 1, "decision_recorded": 1,
    }  # fmt: skip
    assert seeded_p1.summary.counts == expected
    rows = ledger_copy.events()
    assert dict(Counter(r["event_type"] for r in rows)) == expected
    assert seeded_p1.summary.rows == len(rows) == sum(expected.values())
    assert expected["incident_recorded"] > 10 and expected["report_recorded"] > 5


def test_seed_times_follow_15_5(store, ledger_copy) -> None:
    inc = store.sql("SELECT * FROM incidents").set_index("incident_id")
    rep = store.sql("SELECT * FROM reports").set_index("report_id")
    ass = store.sql("SELECT * FROM assessments").set_index("incident_id")
    for r in ledger_copy.events():
        assert r["actor"] == "generator"
        s = r["subject_id"]
        if r["event_type"] == "incident_recorded":
            row = inc.loc[s]
            assert r["recorded_at"] == row.end_ts + timedelta(minutes=5)
            assert (r["valid_from"], r["valid_to"]) == (row.start_ts, row.end_ts)
            assert r["object_json"]["base"] == row.installation_id
        elif r["event_type"] == "report_recorded":
            row = rep.loc[s]
            assert (r["recorded_at"], r["valid_from"], r["source_grade"]) == (
                row.report_ts, row.event_ts, row.source_grade)  # fmt: skip
            assert r["object_json"]["text"] == row.text
        elif r["event_type"] == "assessment_asserted":
            row = ass.loc[s]
            assert (r["recorded_at"], r["object_json"]["label"]) == (row.assessed_ts, row.label)
            assert r["valid_from"] == inc.loc[s].start_ts and r["predicate"] == "assessment"


def test_seed_is_ordered_and_cut_before_first_contact(seeded_p1, ledger_copy) -> None:
    rows = ledger_copy.events()
    times = [r["recorded_at"] for r in rows]
    assert times == sorted(times)
    assert max(times) < seeded_p1.summary.cutoff
    live = {seeded_p1.cfg.scenario.live_incident, "DEMO-SWARM-ECHO-0614"}
    assert not live & {r["subject_id"] for r in rows}
    assert not live & {(r["object_json"] or {}).get("incident_id") for r in rows}


def test_planted_delta_trio_in_order_at_0910_local(seeded_p1, ledger_copy) -> None:
    trio = [r for r in ledger_copy.events() if r["subject_id"] == DELTA
            and r["event_type"] != "incident_recorded"]  # fmt: skip
    assert [r["event_type"] for r in trio] == ["case_opened", "assessment_asserted",
                                               "decision_recorded"]  # fmt: skip
    assert [r["seq"] for r in trio] == [trio[0]["seq"] + i for i in range(3)]
    planted = next(f for f in seeded_p1.cfg.scenario.p1_flights if f.incident_id == DELTA)
    expected = planted.assessment.assessed_local + timedelta(hours=5)  # COASTAL is UTC-5
    assert {r["recorded_at"] for r in trio} == {expected} == {THEN}
    assert trio[2]["object_json"]["decision"] == "close"
    assert trio[2]["object_json"]["rationale"] == "assessed hobbyist"
    assert trio[0]["case_id"] == CASE and trio[1]["object_json"]["author"] == "DELTA BDOC"


def test_delta_known_at_1000_local_hobbyist_closed_no_links(ledger_copy) -> None:
    """SPEC §20 phase 6: the DELTA case as of 2026-04-20 10:00 local."""
    s = ledger_copy.as_of(CASE, local(2026, 4, 20, 10, 0))
    assert s.exists and s.status == "closed"
    assert [c["value"] for c in s.claims] == ["hobbyist"]
    assert s.links == [] and s.pending == [] and s.members == [DELTA]
    assert "R-P1-DELTA-260419-1" in {r["report_id"] for r in s.reports}
    assert s.contradictions == []


def test_delta_case_unknown_at_0900_local(ledger_copy) -> None:
    s = ledger_copy.as_of(CASE, local(2026, 4, 20, 9, 0))
    assert not s.exists and s.status == "unknown" and s.head_seq is not None


def test_no_cross_base_links_in_history(ledger_copy) -> None:
    rows = ledger_copy.events()
    kinds = {r["event_type"] for r in rows}
    assert not kinds & {"match_proposed", "link_approved", "link_rejected", "claim_retracted"}
    assert {r["case_id"] for r in rows if r["case_id"]} == {CASE}


def test_seed_is_deterministic(seeded_p1, store, tmp_path) -> None:
    with DuckCaseMemory(tmp_path / "again.duckdb", seeded_p1.cfg.app) as mem:
        s = seed(mem, store, seeded_p1.cfg.scenario)
    assert (s.head_seq, s.head_hash) == (seeded_p1.summary.head_seq, seeded_p1.summary.head_hash)
    assert seed_events(store, seeded_p1.cfg.scenario) == seed_events(store, seeded_p1.cfg.scenario)


def test_seed_refuses_non_empty_ledger(seeded_p1, store, ledger_copy) -> None:
    n = ledger_copy.count()
    with pytest.raises(SeedError, match="reseed"):
        seed(ledger_copy, store, seeded_p1.cfg.scenario)
    assert ledger_copy.count() == n


def test_three_demo_links_make_three_members_and_diff_lists_them(seeded_p1, store,
                                                                 ledger_copy) -> None:  # fmt: skip
    """SPEC §20 phase 6: approve the scenario's three demo links (hand-written proposals at
    T+90, so the test does not depend on the matcher); the case shows three members and the diff
    lists them, with what ALPHA-260502 brought ("it had not happened yet" at THEN)."""
    sc = seeded_p1.cfg.scenario
    top3 = sc.expectations.live_top3_incidents
    now = seeded_p1.summary.cutoff + timedelta(seconds=sc.expectations.live_top3_at_s)
    ms = [{"incident_id": inc, "score": s, "track_id": f"{inc}-T1", "model_version": "test"}
          for inc, s in zip(top3, (0.97, 0.93, 0.88), strict=True)]  # fmt: skip
    seqs = propose_matches(ledger_copy, CASE, sc.live_incident, ms, now, t_s=90,
                           actor="matcher@test")  # fmt: skip
    assert len(seqs) == 3
    for p in seqs:
        decide_link(ledger_copy, CASE, p, "approve", "test", now, "same pattern")
    s = ledger_copy.as_of(CASE, now)
    assert sorted(s.members) == sorted(top3) and len(s.members) == 3 and s.pending == []
    assert s.status == "closed"  # only an analyst's reopen changes it
    g = group(ledger_copy.diff(CASE, THEN, now))
    assert sorted(i["subject_id"] for i in g["members_added"]) == sorted(top3)
    assert {i["subject_id"]: i["new_member"] for i in g["members_added"]} == {
        DELTA: False, "P1-ALPHA-260303": True, "P1-ALPHA-260502": True}  # fmt: skip
    assert sorted(i["subject_id"] for i in g["proposals"]) == sorted(top3)
    later = "P1-ALPHA-260502"
    reports = set(store.sql("SELECT report_id FROM reports WHERE incident_id = $i",
                            {"i": later}).report_id)  # fmt: skip
    facts = {(i["event_type"], i["subject_id"]) for i in g["facts"]}
    assert facts == {("incident_recorded", later)} | {("report_recorded", r) for r in reports}
    assert [i["subject_id"] for i in g["claims_added"]] == [later]
    assert ledger_copy.verify_chain() is None

    cut = seeded_p1.summary.cutoff
    q = {"c": cut}
    hist = "JOIN incidents i USING (incident_id) WHERE i.status <> 'live'"
    expected = {
        "incident_recorded": store.sql("SELECT count(*) n FROM incidents WHERE status <> 'live' "
                                       "AND end_ts + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE < $c", q).n[0],
        "report_recorded": store.sql(f"SELECT count(*) n FROM reports r {hist} "
                                     "AND r.report_ts < $c", q).n[0],
        "assessment_asserted": store.sql(f"SELECT count(*) n FROM assessments a {hist} "
                                         "AND a.assessed_ts < $c", q).n[0],
        "case_opened": 1, "decision_recorded": 1,
    }  # fmt: skip
    assert seeded_p1.summary.counts == expected
    rows = ledger_copy.events()
    assert dict(Counter(r["event_type"] for r in rows)) == expected
    assert seeded_p1.summary.rows == len(rows) == sum(expected.values())

def test_seed_times_follow_15_5(store, ledger_copy) -> None:

    ass = store.sql("SELECT * FROM assessments").set_index("incident_id")
    for r in ledger_copy.events():
        assert r["actor"] == "generator"
        s = r["subject_id"]
        if r["event_type"] == "incident_recorded":
            row = inc.loc[s]
            assert r["recorded_at"] == row.end_ts + timedelta(minutes=5)
            assert (r["valid_from"], r["valid_to"]) == (row.start_ts, row.end_ts)

            assert (r["recorded_at"], r["valid_from"], r["source_grade"]) == (

    ms = [{"incident_id": inc, "score": s, "track_id": f"{inc}-T1", "model_version": "test"}

    seqs = propose_matches(ledger_copy, CASE, sc.live_incident, ms, now, t_s=90,

    assert sorted(i["subject_id"] for i in g["proposals"]) == sorted(top3)

    reports = set(store.sql("SELECT report_id FROM reports WHERE incident_id = $i",

from kairos_defense.sim.generate import FlightResult, Generated

from kairos_defense.sim.swarm import choreography_clock

    import matplotlib

    matplotlib.use("Agg")
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    return plt


def pick_samples(g: Generated, kind: str, n: int = 3) -> list[FlightResult]:

        key=lambda r: (r.plan.incident_id is None, r.plan.key),
    )
    out, bases = [], set()
    for r in cands:
        if r.plan.installation_id not in bases:
            out.append(r)
            bases.add(r.plan.installation_id)
        if len(out) == n:
            return out
    out += [r for r in cands if r not in out][: n - len(out)]
    return out


def _save(fig, path: Path) -> Path:

    _plt().close(fig)

    plt = _plt()
    samples = pick_samples(g, kind)
    if not samples:

def plot_recall(s: dict, path: Path) -> Path:
    """Recall@5 against T for prober and copycat queries (one axis, two series)."""
    from kairos_defense.sim.figures import INK, INK_2, MUTED, SERIES_PATH, SERIES_RADAR, SURFACE
    from kairos_defense.sim.figures import _plt as plt_

    INK, INK_2, MUTED, SERIES_PATH, SERIES_RADAR, SURFACE = colors
    ts = [int(t) for t, r in s["recall_by_t"].items() if r["ran"]]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.4, 3.6), dpi=110, facecolor=SURFACE)
    ax.set_facecolor(SURFACE)
    n = s["counts"]
    np_, nc = (

    for key, label, color in series:

        if any(y is None for y in ys):  # no answerable queries in this set

    ax.set_ylim(0, 1.02)
    ax.set_xticks(ts)
    ax.set_xlabel("T, seconds after first radar contact", color=INK_2, fontsize=9)
    ax.set_ylabel("Recall@5", color=INK_2, fontsize=9)
    title = "DTW + fusion" if s["method"] == "dtw" else f"{s['method'].title()} baseline"
    ax.set_title(f"{title}: same actor in the top 5", color=INK, fontsize=10, loc="left")
    ax.grid(axis="y", color=MUTED, lw=0.5, alpha=0.4)

    for side in ("left", "bottom"):
        ax.spines[side].set_color(MUTED)

Base directory for this skill: /private/tmp/claude-501/bundled-skills/2.1.312/0b7cd4f16747a51ad4a07ab6755e6f2c/dataviz

# Data Visualization

A chart is **read by people and executed by you**. This skill turns "make it look
good" into a procedure with checks, so the result is right by construction rather
than by taste.

**The method here is design-system-agnostic.** Nothing in the procedure, the form
heuristic, the six checks, or the mark specs is specific to one product. A design
system supplies a small set of *parameters* (its ramps, a categorical order, a
diverging pair, a status palette, a texture, its surfaces, its filter components);
the method consumes them unchanged. A **validated default palette** is the
reference instance, fully specified in `references/palette.md`. To target your
brand, read that file's structure and substitute its values - touch nothing else.

> The single most important habit: **the color part is computable, so compute it.**
> Never eyeball whether a palette is colorblind-safe - run `scripts/validate_palette.js`.

## The procedure - do these in order

Color comes LAST. Most bad charts pick colors first.

1. **Pick the form.** What is the data's job - magnitude, identity, polarity, a
   single headline, change-over-time? The job picks the chart type, and sometimes
   the answer is *not a chart* (a stat tile or hero number). -> `references/choosing-a-form.md`
2. **Assign color by the job it does.** Categorical (identity), sequential
   (magnitude), diverging (polarity), or status (state) - each has one rule.
   Assign categorical hues in fixed order, never cycled. -> `references/color-formula.md`
3. **VALIDATE the palette - run the script, don't reason about Delta E.**
   `node scripts/validate_palette.js "<hex,hex,...>" --mode light` (relative to
   this skill's base directory - or load it as `<script type="module">` in the
   chart's own page, where it reads
   `data-palette` off `<body>` and logs a `console.table` report). It returns
   pass/fail on the lightness band, chroma floor, adjacent-pair CVD separation,
   the normal-vision floor, and contrast. Fix anything that FAILs before continuing. Re-run for
   `--mode dark` with that mode's surface.
4. **Apply mark specs & spacers.** Thin marks, 4px rounded data-ends anchored to
   the baseline, 2px lines, >=8px markers, a 2px surface gap between fills (stacked
   segments and adjacent bars alike) and a 2px surface ring on overlapping marks,
   selective direct labels. -> `references/marks-and-anatomy.md`
5. **Add the hover layer - by default.** An HTML/SVG chart *is* interactive; ship
   a crosshair+tooltip on line/area and a per-mark hover tooltip on bar/dot/cell.
   The only form that skips it is a bare stat tile with no plot. Hit targets bigger
   than the mark; filters in one row above the charts. -> `references/interaction.md`
6. **Final accessibility pass.** For >= 2 series a legend is always present and <= 4
   are also direct-labeled (a single series needs no legend box - the title names
   it), so identity is never color-alone; a table view exists; dark mode is **selected** - its own
   steps from the same ramps, validated against the dark surface, not an automatic
   flip; texture is available for the CVD/print/forced-colors case.
7. **Render it and look at it.** The validator checks color, not layout - open or
   screenshot the output and eyeball it for label collisions, geometry, and overflow
   before calling it done.

Then check the result against **`references/anti-patterns.md`** - it is the catalog
of what goes wrong. If your chart matches an entry, it's wrong.

## Non-negotiables (true in every design system)

- **Assign categorical hues in fixed order, never cycled.** A 9th series is never a
  generated hue - it folds into "Other," small multiples, or composite encoding.
- **One axis.** Never a dual-axis chart (two y-scales). Two measures of different
  scale -> two charts, small multiples, or indexed to a common base. *(This is the
  #1 chart mistake - see anti-patterns.)*
- **Color follows the entity, never its rank.** A filter that changes the series
  count must not repaint the survivors.
- **Sequential = one hue, light->dark. Diverging = two hues + a neutral gray
  midpoint.** Never a rainbow; never a hue at the diverging midpoint.
- **Run the validator before shipping any categorical palette.** CVD Delta E >= 8 is the
  target (OKLab ×100); 6-8 is a floor that is legal ONLY with secondary encoding. A
  normal-vision floor below 15 is a hard FAIL - full-color readers can't tell the
  pair apart; re-step it on the adjacent pairlist (secondary encoding does not excuse
  this one); under `--pairs all` cut series or facet instead - see check 4. A contrast WARN
  obligates visible labels or a table view - it is not dismissable.
- **Thin marks; a legend always present for >= 2 series (none for one), with
  selective direct labels (never a number on every point); recessive grid/axes.**
- **Text wears text tokens, never the series color** - values, labels, and legends
  stay in primary/secondary/muted ink; a colored mark beside them carries identity.
- **Status colors are reserved** (good/warning/serious/critical) and never reused
  for "series 4"; they ship with an icon + label, never color alone.

## Plugging in a design system

The method is invariant; only these parameters change per system. The reference
instance - every value filled in - is `references/palette.md`.

| Parameter | What the system provides |
|---|---|
| **Ramps** | the hue scales (named steps) the palette draws from |
| **Categorical theme** | the fixed hue order (a named theme); default + alternates |
| **Sequential hue** | the default single hue for magnitude |
| **Diverging pair** | two warm/cool poles + a neutral midpoint |
| **Status palette** | good / warning / serious / critical - steps distinct from categorical |
| **Texture fill** | one directional hand-drawn fill, used at 45° / 135° |
| **Surfaces** | light & dark chart-surface colors (the validator needs these) |
| **Filter controls** | date-range & dimension controls (behavioral spec in `interaction.md`) |

To onboard a new system: fill those rows, feed its ramps to the validator, and let
it snap each slot to the nearest passing step. Structure and rules stay as written.

## Reference files

| File | What it answers |
|------|-----------------|
| `references/choosing-a-form.md` | Which chart type / is it even a chart? |
| `references/color-formula.md` | The four jobs, the six checks, snap-to-passing |
| `references/marks-and-anatomy.md` | Mark specs, spacers, labels, figures, hero number |
| `references/interaction.md` | Tooltips & hover, filters & time ranges |
| `references/components.md` | The pieces a chart is made of - build each in plain HTML |
| `references/anti-patterns.md` | **What goes wrong - check every chart against this** |
| `references/palette.md` | **The reference palette instance** - every parameter, filled in; swap for your brand's |
| `scripts/validate_palette.js` | Runnable six-checks validator (run it; don't eyeball) |

"""SPEC §15.7 evidence packages: approval, the five files, the Ed25519 manifest signature and
verification (D-099). A fixed test key keeps the tests deterministic."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import stat
from datetime import timedelta

import pytest
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PrivateKey

from kairos_defense.memory.actions import decide_link, propose_matches
from kairos_defense.memory.canonical import sha256_bytes
from kairos_defense.memory.evidence import (
    ApprovalRequired,
    Signer,
    export_evidence,
    load_or_create_key,
    package_dir,
    passed,
    signer_for,
    verify_evidence,
)
from kairos_defense.store.duck import DuckTrackStore
from kairos_defense.store.ledger_duck import DuckCaseMemory
from tests.unit.memory_kit import delta_story, local

CASE = "CASE-P1-DELTA-260419"
DELTA = "P1-DELTA-260419"
NOW = local(2026, 8, 28, 21, 42)
KEY = Signer(Ed25519PrivateKey.from_private_bytes(b"\x01" * 32))
OTHER = Signer(Ed25519PrivateKey.from_private_bytes(b"\x02" * 32))


@pytest.fixture
def mem(cfg, tmp_path):
    with DuckCaseMemory(tmp_path / "mem.duckdb", cfg.app) as m:
        m.append_many(delta_story())
        top = [{"incident_id": i, "score": s, "track_id": f"{i}-T1", "model_version": "fusion-v1",
                "reasons": ["Same RF family (FAM-07)"]}
               for i, s in ((DELTA, 0.97), ("P1-ALPHA-260303", 0.93))]  # fmt: skip
        for p in propose_matches(m, CASE, "DEMO-BRAVO-0828", top, NOW):
            decide_link(m, CASE, p, "approve", "test", NOW)
        yield m


def _export(mem, tmp_path, signer=KEY, **kw):
    return export_evidence(mem, CASE, approve=True, approved_by="analyst:test", clock=NOW,
                           out_root=tmp_path / "exports", signer=signer, **kw)  # fmt: skip


def _status(checks) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {c.name: c.status for c in checks}


def test_export_requires_approval(mem, tmp_path) -> None:
    n = mem.count()
    with pytest.raises(ApprovalRequired, match="rule 8"):
        export_evidence(mem, CASE, approve=False, approved_by="analyst:test", clock=NOW,
                        out_root=tmp_path / "exports", signer=KEY)  # fmt: skip
    assert not (tmp_path / "exports").exists() and mem.count() == n


def test_export_writes_five_files_and_appends_event(mem, tmp_path) -> None:
    head = mem.head()
    res = _export(mem, tmp_path)
    names = sorted(p.name for p in res.path.iterdir())
    assert names == ["case.html", "case.json", "manifest.json", "manifest.sig", "pubkey.pem"]
    assert res.path.name == f"{CASE}_20260829T024200" and res.signed
    row = mem.events()[-1]
    assert (row["seq"], row["event_type"], row["actor"], row["case_id"]) == (
        res.seq, "evidence_exported", "system", CASE)  # fmt: skip
    assert row["object_json"]["manifest_sha256"] == res.manifest_sha256 == sha256_bytes(
        (res.path / "manifest.json").read_bytes())  # fmt: skip
    assert row["object_json"]["approved_by"] == "analyst:test"
    assert res.head_seq == head.seq == res.seq - 1
    assert mem.as_of(CASE, NOW).exports[0]["manifest_sha256"] == res.manifest_sha256


def test_case_json_has_rows_head_verification_models(mem, tmp_path) -> None:
    res = _export(mem, tmp_path)
    doc = json.loads((res.path / "case.json").read_text())
    touching = {r["seq"] for r in mem.events() if r["seq"] < res.seq} - {1}  # not ALPHA-0303's?
    seqs = [r["seq"] for r in doc["rows"]]
    assert set(seqs) == touching  # ALPHA-0303 is a member now, so its incident row touches too
    assert all(len(r["hash"]) == 64 and len(r["prev_hash"]) == 64 for r in doc["rows"])
    assert doc["head"]["seq"] == res.head_seq and doc["verification"] == {
        "intact": True, "first_broken_seq": None, "rows": res.head_seq}  # fmt: skip
    assert doc["models"] == ["fusion-v1"]
    assert doc["snapshot"]["members"] == [DELTA, "P1-ALPHA-260303"]
    assert doc["snapshot"]["status"] == "closed"


def test_html_is_self_contained(mem, tmp_path, seeded_p1, ledger_copy) -> None:
    html = (_export(mem, tmp_path).path / "case.html").read_text()

    assert "No map" in html and "Same RF family (FAM-07)" in html and "white pickup" in html
    with DuckTrackStore(seeded_p1.cfg.app.paths.duckdb, seeded_p1.cfg.app) as store:
        t = seeded_p1.summary.cutoff + timedelta(seconds=90)
        top = [{"incident_id": i, "score": 0.9, "model_version": "test"}
               for i in ("P1-ALPHA-260303", "P1-CHARLIE-260710")]  # fmt: skip
        for p in propose_matches(ledger_copy, CASE, "DEMO-BRAVO-0828", top, t):
            decide_link(ledger_copy, CASE, p, "approve", "test", t)
        res = export_evidence(ledger_copy, CASE, approve=True, approved_by="analyst:test",
                              clock=t, out_root=tmp_path / "p1", signer=KEY, store=store)
    page = (res.path / "case.html").read_text()
    assert len(re.findall(r'src="data:image/png;base64,', page)) == 1
    assert "<script" not in page.lower() and not re.search(r"(src|href)=\"https?:", page)


def test_verify_passes(mem, tmp_path) -> None:
    res = _export(mem, tmp_path)
    checks = verify_evidence(res.path, mem, KEY.public_pem())
    assert _status(checks) == {"files": "PASS", "signature": "PASS", "chain": "PASS",
                               "ledger": "PASS"} and passed(checks)  # fmt: skip


def test_verify_fails_after_editing_one_file(mem, tmp_path) -> None:
    """SPEC §20 phase 6: evidence verify passes, then fails after editing one file."""
    res = _export(mem, tmp_path)
    assert passed(verify_evidence(res.path, mem))
    page = res.path / "case.html"
    page.write_bytes(page.read_bytes().replace(b"closed", b"clozed", 1))
    checks = verify_evidence(res.path, mem)
    files = next(c for c in checks if c.name == "files")
    assert files.status == "FAIL" and "case.html" in files.detail and not passed(checks)
    assert _status(checks)["signature"] == "PASS"  # the manifest itself is untouched


def test_verify_fails_on_missing_or_extra_file(mem, tmp_path) -> None:
    res = _export(mem, tmp_path)
    (res.path / "notes.txt").write_text("added later")
    assert "notes.txt" in next(c for c in verify_evidence(res.path) if c.name == "files").detail
    (res.path / "notes.txt").unlink()
    (res.path / "pubkey.pem").unlink()
    st = _status(verify_evidence(res.path))
    assert st["files"] == "FAIL" and st["signature"] == "FAIL"


def test_verify_fails_on_bad_signature_or_pinned_key_mismatch(mem, tmp_path) -> None:
    res = _export(mem, tmp_path)
    m = res.path / "manifest.json"
    original = m.read_bytes()
    m.write_bytes(original.replace(b"sha256", b"sha257", 1))
    assert _status(verify_evidence(res.path))["signature"] == "FAIL"
    m.write_bytes(original)
    other = _export(mem, tmp_path, signer=OTHER)
    assert _status(verify_evidence(other.path))["signature"] == "PASS"  # self-consistent ...
    pinned = verify_evidence(other.path, pubkey_pem=KEY.public_pem())
    sig = next(c for c in pinned if c.name == "signature")
    assert sig.status == "FAIL" and "pinned" in sig.detail  # ... but not the expected key


def test_verify_checks_the_ledger_when_available(mem, tmp_path) -> None:
    res = _export(mem, tmp_path)
    assert _status(verify_evidence(res.path, None, ledger_note="ledger missing"))["ledger"] == (
        "SKIP")  # fmt: skip
    mem.con.execute("UPDATE ledger SET object_json = '{\"label\":\"probing\"}' WHERE seq = 5")
    led = next(c for c in verify_evidence(res.path, mem) if c.name == "ledger")
    assert led.status == "FAIL" and "seq 5" in led.detail


def test_signing_key_created_once_with_0600(tmp_path, cfg) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "keys" / "ed25519.pem"
    a = load_or_create_key(path)
    assert stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) == 0o600
    b = load_or_create_key(path)
    assert Signer(a).public_pem() == Signer(b).public_pem()
    app = cfg.app.model_copy(update={"signing": cfg.app.signing.model_copy(
        update={"key_path": path})})  # fmt: skip
    assert signer_for(app).public_pem() == Signer(a).public_pem()


def test_unsigned_package_fails_verification(mem, tmp_path, cfg) -> None:
    off = cfg.app.model_copy(update={"signing": cfg.app.signing.model_copy(
        update={"enabled": False})})  # fmt: skip
    assert signer_for(off) is None
    res = _export(mem, tmp_path, signer=None)
    assert not res.signed and not (res.path / "manifest.sig").exists()
    st = _status(verify_evidence(res.path))
    assert st["signature"] == "FAIL" and st["files"] == "PASS"


def test_export_folder_name_and_collision_suffix(mem, tmp_path) -> None:
    a = _export(mem, tmp_path)
    b = _export(mem, tmp_path)
    assert b.path.name == f"{a.path.name}-2"
    assert package_dir(tmp_path / "exports", CASE, NOW).name == f"{a.path.name}-3"

"""Rich tables for the case-memory commands (``memory …``, ``export``, ``verify-evidence``).

Times print as the case's local time with UTC beside it, e.g. ``2026-04-20 09:10 local
(14:10Z)``; the offset is the region of the case's base (``config/world.yaml``).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from rich.table import Table


def when(t: datetime | None, offset: int) -> str:
    if t is None:
        return "-"
    loc = t + timedelta(hours=offset)
    return f"{loc:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} local ({t:%H:%M}Z)"


def _short(h: str | None) -> str:
    return "-" if not h else f"{h[:16]}…"


def snapshot_lines(s, offset: int) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """(item, value) rows describing one ``CaseSnapshot``."""
    if not s.exists:
        return [("status", "unknown: no such case yet"), ("members", "-"), ("links", "-"),
                ("pending proposals", "-"), ("assessments", "-"), ("contradictions", "-"),
                ("decisions", "-"), ("reports", "-"), ("exports", "-"),
                ("chain head", f"seq {s.head_seq} {_short(s.head_hash)}")]  # fmt: skip
    claims = "\n".join(f"{c['value']} ({c['author'] or c['actor']}, seq {c['seq']})"
                       for c in s.claims) or "none"  # fmt: skip
    contra = "\n".join(f"{c['subject_id']}: {' vs '.join(map(str, c['values']))}"
                       for c in s.contradictions) or "none"  # fmt: skip
    links = "\n".join(f"{lk['incident_id']} ({lk['actor']}, seq {lk['seq']})"
                      for lk in s.links) or "none"  # fmt: skip
    pending = "\n".join(f"{p['incident_id']} (rank {p['rank']}, score "
                        f"{'-' if p['score'] is None else format(p['score'], '.3f')}, "
                        f"seq {p['seq']})" for p in s.pending) or "none"  # fmt: skip
    decisions = "\n".join(f"{d['decision']}: {d['rationale']} ({when(d['recorded_at'], offset)})"
                          for d in s.decisions) or "none"  # fmt: skip
    reports = "\n".join(f"{r['report_id']} ({r['source']}, {r['grade']})"
                        for r in s.reports) or "none"  # fmt: skip
    exports = "\n".join(f"{e['manifest_sha256'][:16]}… (seq {e['seq']})"
                        for e in s.exports) or "none"  # fmt: skip
    return [("status", s.status), ("members", f"{len(s.members)}: " + ", ".join(s.members)),
            ("links", links), ("pending proposals", pending), ("assessments", claims),
            ("contradictions", contra), ("decisions", decisions), ("reports", reports),
            ("exports", exports),
            ("chain head", f"seq {s.head_seq} {_short(s.head_hash)}")]  # fmt: skip


def snapshot_table(s, offset: int) -> Table:
    t = Table(title=f"{s.case_id} as known at {when(s.as_of, offset)}", title_justify="left")
    t.add_column("item")
    t.add_column("value")
    for k, v in snapshot_lines(s, offset):
        t.add_row(k, v)
    return t


def side_by_side(then, now, offset: int) -> Table:
    """The demo's "known then" and "known now" columns for one case."""
    t = Table(title=f"{then.case_id}: known then and known now", title_justify="left",
              show_lines=True)  # fmt: skip
    t.add_column("item")
    t.add_column(f"known then\n{when(then.as_of, offset)}")
    t.add_column(f"known now\n{when(now.as_of, offset)}")
    for (k, a), (_, b) in zip(snapshot_lines(then, offset), snapshot_lines(now, offset),
                              strict=True):  # fmt: skip
        t.add_row(k, a, b)
    return t


def items_table(title: str, groups: Mapping[str, Sequence[Mapping]], offset: int) -> Table:
    """Grouped diff or delta items: group, seq, recorded time, summary (empty groups skipped)."""
    t = Table(title=title, title_justify="left")
    for c in ("group", "seq", "recorded", "summary"):
        t.add_column(c, justify="right" if c == "seq" else "left")
    for g, items in groups.items():
        for i in items:
            extra = ""
            if "new_member" in i:
                extra = " · new member" if i["new_member"] else " · already a member"
            t.add_row(g, str(i["seq"]), when(i["recorded_at"], offset), i["summary"] + extra)
    if not t.rows:
        t.add_row("-", "-", "-", "nothing recorded in this window")
    return t


def seed_table(s, title: str) -> Table:
    t = Table(title=title, title_justify="left")
    t.add_column("item")
    t.add_column("value", justify="right")
    for k, v in sorted(s.counts.items()):
        t.add_row(k, f"{v:,}")
    t.add_row("rows", f"{s.rows:,}")
    t.add_row("cutoff (live first contact)", f"{s.cutoff:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}Z")
    t.add_row("head", f"seq {s.head_seq:,} {s.head_hash}")
    t.add_row("elapsed", f"{s.elapsed_s:.2f} s")
    return t


def checks_table(folder: str, checks: Sequence) -> Table:
    t = Table(title=f"verify-evidence {folder}", title_justify="left")
    t.add_column("check")
    t.add_column("result")
    t.add_column("detail")
    style = {"PASS": "green", "FAIL": "red", "SKIP": "yellow"}
    for c in checks:
        t.add_row(c.name, f"[{style[c.status]}]{c.status}[/{style[c.status]}]", c.detail)
    return t

"""``kairos-defense memory …``, ``export`` and ``verify-evidence`` (phase 6, SPEC §15, D-100).

Registered on the Typer app by ``cli.py`` (``register(app)``); shared helpers are looked up on
``kairos_defense.cli`` at call time, so tests that patch ``cli._load_config`` cover these too.
Times given on the command line need ``Z`` or an offset (``2026-04-20T10:00-05:00``): a naive
time is ambiguous across three regions. Every failure a user can fix exits 1 with the fix.
Nothing here reads truth.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

import typer

from kairos_defense.memory.canonical import utc_naive

CONFIG_HELP = "Folder with the five YAML files."
LEDGER_HELP = "Ledger file (default: paths.memory)."

memory_app = typer.Typer(help="Case memory (Kairos-lite): seed, reseed, verify, show, delta, "
                         "and the known-then / known-now demo.", no_args_is_help=True)  # fmt: skip


def _base():
    from kairos_defense import cli

    return cli


def parse_time(s: str) -> datetime:
    """Naive UTC from an ISO 8601 time with ``Z`` or an offset; exit 1 otherwise."""
    cli = _base()
    try:
        t = datetime.fromisoformat(s)
    except ValueError:
        t = None
    if t is None or t.tzinfo is None:
        cli.console.print(f"[red]bad time {s!r}:[/red] give an ISO 8601 time with Z or an offset, "
                          "e.g. 2026-04-20T10:00-05:00 or 2026-04-20T15:00Z")  # fmt: skip
        raise typer.Exit(1)
    return utc_naive(t)


def _offsets(cfg) -> dict[str, int]:
    return {i.id: r.utc_offset_hours for r in cfg.world.regions for i in r.installations}


def _case_offset(rows: list[dict], case_id: str, cfg) -> int:
    f = next((r for r in rows if r["event_type"] == "case_opened" and r["case_id"] == case_id),
             None)  # fmt: skip
    base = (f["object_json"] or {}).get("base") if f else None
    return _offsets(cfg).get(base, 0)


def _open(cfg, ledger: str | None, *, read_only: bool, must_exist: bool = True):
    """The ledger adapter, or exit 1 (missing, locked, wrong schema)."""
    from kairos_defense.memory.ledger import LedgerError
    from kairos_defense.store.ledger_duck import DuckCaseMemory

    cli = _base()
    path = Path(ledger or cfg.app.paths.memory)
    if must_exist and not path.exists():
        cli.console.print(f"[red]no ledger:[/red] {path} is missing; run "
                          "`kairos-defense memory seed`.")  # fmt: skip
        raise typer.Exit(1)
    try:
        return DuckCaseMemory(path, cfg.app, read_only=read_only)
    except LedgerError as exc:
        cli._fail(exc)


def _seed_into(cfg, path: Path):
    from kairos_defense.memory.seed import SeedError, seed
    from kairos_defense.store.duck import DuckTrackStore

    cli = _base()
    cli._need_data(cfg)
    with DuckTrackStore(cfg.app.paths.duckdb, cfg.app) as store:
        mem = _open(cfg, str(path), read_only=False, must_exist=False)
        try:
            return seed(mem, store, cfg.scenario), mem
        except SeedError as exc:
            mem.close()
            cli._fail(exc)


@memory_app.command("seed")
def seed_cmd(config: str = typer.Option("config", help=CONFIG_HELP)) -> None:
    """Seed an empty ledger with history as Kairos Defense would have learned it (§15.5)."""
    from kairos_defense.cli_memory_view import seed_table

    cli = _base()
    cfg = cli._load_config(config)
    s, mem = _seed_into(cfg, Path(cfg.app.paths.memory))
    mem.close()
    cli.console.print(seed_table(s, f"kairos-defense memory seed → {cfg.app.paths.memory}"))


def _remove(*paths: Path) -> None:
    for p in paths:
        if p.exists():
            p.unlink()


@memory_app.command("reseed")
def reseed_cmd(config: str = typer.Option("config", help=CONFIG_HELP)) -> None:
    """Rebuild the ledger from scratch (reset between demo runs, D-010): seed a temporary file,
    verify it, then replace the ledger."""
    import duckdb

    from kairos_defense.cli_memory_view import seed_table
    from kairos_defense.store.guard import connect_app_db

    cli = _base()
    cfg = cli._load_config(config)
    path = Path(cfg.app.paths.memory)
    if path.exists():
        try:
            connect_app_db(path, cfg.app).close()
        except duckdb.IOException as exc:
            cli.console.print(f"[red]ledger in use:[/red] {path} is held by another process. "
                              "Stop `make demo` (or the API) and rerun, or reset through the "
                              f"running API (D-010). {exc}")  # fmt: skip
            raise typer.Exit(1) from exc
    tmp = path.with_name(path.name + ".reseed.tmp")
    _remove(tmp, Path(f"{tmp}.wal"))
    s, mem = _seed_into(cfg, tmp)
    broken = mem.verify_chain()
    mem.close()
    if broken is not None:
        _remove(tmp)
        cli.console.print(f"[red]reseed failed:[/red] the new chain is broken at seq {broken}; "
                          f"{path} is unchanged")  # fmt: skip
        raise typer.Exit(1)
    _remove(Path(f"{path}.wal"))
    os.replace(tmp, path)
    cli.console.print(seed_table(s, f"kairos-defense memory reseed → {path} (verified)"))


@memory_app.command("verify")
def verify_cmd(ledger: str | None = typer.Option(None, help=LEDGER_HELP),
               config: str = typer.Option("config", help=CONFIG_HELP)) -> None:  # fmt: skip
    """Recompute every hash in seq order (§15.3); exit 1 at the first broken seq."""
    cli = _base()
    cfg = cli._load_config(config)
    with _open(cfg, ledger, read_only=True) as mem:
        n, broken, head = mem.count(), mem.verify_chain(), mem.head()
    where = ledger or cfg.app.paths.memory
    if broken is not None:
        cli.console.print(f"[red]chain broken at seq {broken}[/red] in {where} ({n:,} rows)")
        raise typer.Exit(1)
    if head is None:
        cli.console.print(f"chain intact: 0 rows in {where} (empty: run `memory seed`)")
        return
    cli.console.print(f"chain intact: {n:,} rows in {where}, head seq {head.seq:,} hash "
                      f"{head.hash} recorded {head.recorded_at:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}Z")  # fmt: skip


@memory_app.command("show")
def show_cmd(case: str = typer.Argument(..., help="Case id, e.g. CASE-P1-DELTA-260419."),
             as_of: str = typer.Option(..., "--as-of", help="Transaction time (Z or offset)."),
             ledger: str | None = typer.Option(None, help=LEDGER_HELP),
             config: str = typer.Option("config", help=CONFIG_HELP)) -> None:  # fmt: skip
    """Print a case as Kairos Defense knew it at a moment (transaction time, §15.4)."""
    from kairos_defense.cli_memory_view import snapshot_table
    from kairos_defense.memory.asof import snapshot

    cli = _base()
    cfg = cli._load_config(config)
    t = parse_time(as_of)
    with _open(cfg, ledger, read_only=True) as mem:
        rows = mem.events()
    cli.console.print(snapshot_table(snapshot(rows, case, t), _case_offset(rows, case, cfg)))


@memory_app.command("delta")
def delta_cmd(since: str = typer.Option(..., help="Start of the shift, exclusive (Z or offset)."),
              until: str | None = typer.Option(None, help="End, inclusive (default: the head)."),
              installation: str | None = typer.Option(None, help="Only this base, e.g. BRAVO."),
              ledger: str | None = typer.Option(None, help=LEDGER_HELP),
              config: str = typer.Option("config", help=CONFIG_HELP)) -> None:  # fmt: skip
    """What the memory learned during a shift, grouped, with seqs (§15.8)."""
    from kairos_defense.cli_memory_view import items_table
    from kairos_defense.memory.delta import delta

    cli = _base()
    cfg = cli._load_config(config)
    t0 = parse_time(since)
    with _open(cfg, ledger, read_only=True) as mem:
        rows, head = mem.events(), mem.head()
    t1 = parse_time(until) if until else (head.recorded_at if head else t0)
    d = delta(rows, t0, t1, installation)
    off = _offsets(cfg).get(installation, 0) if installation else 0
    tz = "local" if installation else "UTC"
    cli.console.print(items_table(f"shift delta {installation or 'all bases'} ({tz}): "
                                  f"{d.count} items, head seq {d.head_seq}", d.groups, off))


def register(app: typer.Typer) -> None:
    from kairos_defense import cli_memory_demo

    app.add_typer(memory_app, name="memory")
    memory_app.command("demo")(cli_memory_demo.demo_cmd)
    app.command(name="export")(cli_memory_demo.export_cmd)
    app.command(name="verify-evidence")(cli_memory_demo.verify_evidence_cmd)


def _models_validation(models_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, dict]:
    from kairos_defense.match.fusion import MODEL_FILE

    path = Path(models_dir) / MODEL_FILE
    return path, json.loads(path.read_text()).get("validation", {})

"""``memory demo``, ``export`` and ``verify-evidence`` (phase 6, SPEC §15.6, §15.7, D-098 to D-100).

``memory demo`` copies the seeded ledger to a scratch file (the real ledger stays at seed state),
records tonight's incident, registers the model, proposes the **real** matcher's top 3 at T as
links into the planted case and, only with ``--approve`` (rule 8), approves them as
``analyst:<handle>``. It prints "known then" (when the case was closed) and "known now" (the
scratch head) side by side, then the grouped diff.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import typer

from kairos_defense.cli_memory import (
    CONFIG_HELP,
    LEDGER_HELP,
    _base,
    _case_offset,
    _models_validation,
    _open,
    _remove,
    parse_time,
)


def _default_case(cfg) -> str:
    from kairos_defense.memory.seed import planted_cases

    planted = planted_cases(cfg.scenario)
    return f"CASE-{planted[0]}" if planted else ""


def _scratch_copy(cfg, scratch: Path):
    """A verified copy of the seeded ledger at ``scratch`` (writable), or exit 1."""
    from kairos_defense.memory.ledger import LedgerError

    cli = _base()
    with _open(cfg, None, read_only=True) as src:
        src_head = src.head()
    if src_head is None:
        cli.console.print("[red]empty ledger:[/red] run `kairos-defense memory seed` first.")
        raise typer.Exit(1)
    _remove(scratch, Path(f"{scratch}.wal"))
    mem = _open(cfg, str(scratch), read_only=False, must_exist=False)
    try:
        mem.copy_from(cfg.app.paths.memory)
    except LedgerError as exc:
        mem.close()
        cli._fail(exc)
    if mem.verify_chain() is not None or mem.head() != src_head:
        mem.close()
        cli.console.print("[red]the scratch copy does not match the ledger[/red]")
        raise typer.Exit(1)
    return mem


def demo_cmd(
    at: int | None = typer.Option(None, help="T in seconds (default: live_top3_at_s, 90)."),
    approve: bool = typer.Option(False, "--approve", help="Approve the proposals (rule 8)."),
    analyst: str = typer.Option("demo", help="Analyst handle that approves."),
    case: str | None = typer.Option(None, help="Case the proposals target (default: DELTA's)."),
    scratch: str | None = typer.Option(None, help="Scratch ledger (default: cache folder)."),
    config: str = typer.Option("config", help=CONFIG_HELP),
) -> None:
    """Terminal demo: the planted case "known then" and "known now", side by side (§15.6)."""
    from kairos_defense.cli_memory_view import items_table, side_by_side
    from kairos_defense.cli_recall import _query_and_matches
    from kairos_defense.memory.actions import (
        decide_link,
        file_sha256,
        propose_matches,
        record_incident,
        register_model,
    )
    from kairos_defense.memory.diff import group
    from kairos_defense.memory.ledger import InvalidEvent
    from kairos_defense.store.duck import DuckTrackStore

    cli = _base()
    cfg = cli._load_config(config)
    cli._need_data(cfg)
    lance = cli._need_index(cfg)
    at = int(at if at is not None else cfg.scenario.expectations.live_top3_at_s)
    case = case or _default_case(cfg)
    live = cfg.scenario.live_incident
    path = Path(scratch or Path(cfg.app.paths.cache) / "memory_demo.duckdb")
    with DuckTrackStore(cfg.app.paths.duckdb, cfg.app) as store:
        q, res = _query_and_matches(store, lance, cfg, live, None, at, "dtw")
        inc = store.sql("SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE incident_id = $i", {"i": live})
        inc = inc.iloc[0].to_dict()
    mem = _scratch_copy(cfg, path)
    with mem:
        rows = mem.events()
        founder = next((r for r in rows if r["event_type"] == "case_opened"
                        and r["case_id"] == case), None)  # fmt: skip
        if founder is None:
            cli.console.print(f"[red]unknown case {case}[/red] in the seeded ledger")
            raise typer.Exit(1)
        then = founder["recorded_at"]
        clock = q.until
        try:
            record_incident(mem, inc, inc["start_ts"])
            model_file, validation = _models_validation(cfg.app.paths.models)
            register_model(mem, res.matches[0].model_version, file_sha256(model_file), clock,
                           model_file.as_posix(), validation)  # fmt: skip
            seqs = propose_matches(mem, case, live, res.matches, clock, query_track=q.track_id,
                                   t_s=at)  # fmt: skip
            if approve:
                for s in seqs:
                    decide_link(mem, case, s, "approve", analyst, clock,
                                "approved in the terminal demo")  # fmt: skip
        except (InvalidEvent, ValueError) as exc:
            cli._fail(exc)
        now = mem.head().recorded_at
        rows = mem.events()
        before, after = mem.as_of(case, then), mem.as_of(case, now)
        items = mem.diff(case, then, now)
        broken = mem.verify_chain()
    off = _case_offset(rows, case, cfg)
    top = ", ".join(f"{m.incident_id} {m.score:.3f}" for m in res.matches[:3])
    cli.console.print(f"query {q.track_id} at T+{at} s · model {res.matches[0].model_version} · "
                      f"real top 3: {top}")  # fmt: skip
    cli.console.print(side_by_side(before, after, off))
    cli.console.print(items_table(f"diff {case}: (known then, known now]", group(items), off))
    state = "approved" if approve else "pending (rerun with --approve to link them)"
    cli.console.print(f"{len(seqs)} proposals {state}; scratch ledger {path} "
                      f"({len(rows):,} rows, chain {'intact' if broken is None else 'BROKEN'}); "
                      f"{cfg.app.paths.memory} is unchanged")  # fmt: skip


def export_cmd(
    case: str = typer.Option(..., help="Case id, e.g. CASE-P1-DELTA-260419."),
    approve: bool = typer.Option(False, "--approve", help="Explicit approval (rule 8)."),
    analyst: str = typer.Option("demo", help="Analyst handle that approves."),
    at: str | None = typer.Option(None, help="Export clock (Z or offset; default: the head)."),
    ledger: str | None = typer.Option(None, help=LEDGER_HELP),
    out: str | None = typer.Option(None, help="Output folder (default: paths.exports)."),
    config: str = typer.Option("config", help=CONFIG_HELP),
) -> None:
    """Export a signed evidence package for a case (needs --approve, §15.7)."""
    from kairos_defense.memory.evidence import EvidenceError, export_evidence, signer_for
    from kairos_defense.memory.evidence import fingerprint as fp
    from kairos_defense.memory.ledger import InvalidEvent
    from kairos_defense.memory.ledger import analyst as as_analyst
    from kairos_defense.store.duck import DuckTrackStore

    cli = _base()
    if not approve:
        cli.console.print("[red]approval required (rule 8):[/red] an export needs an explicit "
                          "human approval; rerun with --approve. Nothing was written.")  # fmt: skip
        raise typer.Exit(1)
    cfg = cli._load_config(config)
    try:
        who = as_analyst(analyst)
    except InvalidEvent as exc:
        cli._fail(exc)
    clock = parse_time(at) if at else None
    store = (DuckTrackStore(cfg.app.paths.duckdb, cfg.app)
             if Path(cfg.app.paths.duckdb).exists() else None)  # fmt: skip
    try:
        with _open(cfg, ledger, read_only=False) as mem:
            head = mem.head()
            if head is None:
                cli.console.print("[red]empty ledger:[/red] run `kairos-defense memory seed`.")
                raise typer.Exit(1)
            signer = signer_for(cfg.app)
            res = export_evidence(mem, case, approve=True, approved_by=who,
                                  clock=clock or head.recorded_at,
                                  out_root=out or cfg.app.paths.exports, signer=signer,
                                  store=store)  # fmt: skip
    except EvidenceError as exc:
        cli._fail(exc)
    finally:
        if store is not None:
            store.close()
    key = f"signed, key {fp(signer.public_pem())}" if signer else "UNSIGNED (signing disabled)"
    cli.console.print(f"exported {res.path}/ · manifest sha256 {res.manifest_sha256} · {key} · "
                      f"records head seq {res.head_seq:,} · appended evidence_exported seq "
                      f"{res.seq:,}")  # fmt: skip


def verify_evidence_cmd(
    folder: str = typer.Argument(..., help="Package folder under exports/."),
    ledger: str | None = typer.Option(None, help=LEDGER_HELP),
    pubkey: str | None = typer.Option(None, help="Expected public key (PEM) to pin."),
    config: str = typer.Option("config", help=CONFIG_HELP),
) -> None:
    """Verify an evidence package: file hashes, the Ed25519 signature, chain continuity and the
    rows against the ledger; prints a PASS/FAIL/SKIP table, exit 1 on any FAIL."""
    from kairos_defense.cli_memory_view import checks_table
    from kairos_defense.memory.evidence import passed, verify_evidence
    from kairos_defense.memory.ledger import LedgerError
    from kairos_defense.store.ledger_duck import DuckCaseMemory

    cli = _base()
    cfg = cli._load_config(config)
    if not Path(folder).is_dir():
        cli.console.print(f"[red]no package:[/red] {folder} is not a folder")
        raise typer.Exit(1)
    pem = Path(pubkey).read_bytes() if pubkey else None
    path = Path(ledger or cfg.app.paths.memory)
    mem, note = None, f"no ledger at {path}"
    if path.exists():
        try:
            mem = DuckCaseMemory(path, cfg.app, read_only=True)
        except LedgerError as exc:
            note = f"ledger not readable ({type(exc).__name__}): {exc}"
    try:
        checks = verify_evidence(folder, mem, pem, ledger_note=note)
    finally:
        if mem is not None:
            mem.close()
    cli.console.print(checks_table(folder, checks))
    ok = passed(checks)
    cli.console.print("[green]PASS[/green]: the package verifies" if ok
                      else "[red]FAIL[/red]: the package does not verify")  # fmt: skip
    if not ok:
        raise typer.Exit(1)
